content:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for embeddings service in eu-west — elevated 5xx starting ~14:07 UTC, paging @maria (pager://inc/98765)

maria: I'm on it. Kicking off triage and will update here. Moving noisy logs to #incidents-debug.

sam: Heads-up: recent runtime push touched tokenizer and kv cache. If it's memory-related, revert path ready. @maria

lee: Scaling the eu embed pool +2 nodes and enabling fallback to stable-model v2-embed for new traffic.

jenna: I'll draft an initial public blurb. Need impact classification (degraded vs failing) before publish.

maria: Quick forensic: 5xx concentrated on long inputs (>4k tokens). Short inputs mostly OK. Intermittent tokenizer OOM traces in logs.

jenna: Initial statuspage draft (please edit):
"Summary: We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting the embeddings service in eu-west. Some requests, primarily very long inputs, may fail"
"Impact: A subset of embedding requests may return 5xx errors; successful requests may see increased latency."
"Workaround: Retry or reduce input length. We're rolling mitigation now."
"Next update: in 15 minutes or as events warrant."

alex-legal: Suggest cautious phrasing re data: replace any absolute "no data loss" with "No known customer data loss at this time."

jenna: Updated copy per legal. I'll publish initial now once we agree.

maria: Mitigations in flight: scaled pool + routing to fallback. Rolling back latest tokenizer optimization on suspect nodes. Error rate dropping to ~3%.

sam: Good — keep RCAs internal. Public should be impact + mitigation + ETA only.

jenna: Publishing initial update as "Investigating — mitigation in progress" with the revised wording. (Statuspage: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/embeddings-eu-abc)

lee: Rollback finished at 14:32 UTC; draining traffic from the problematic runtime build. Observability shows OOM traces decreasing.

maria: 15-min follow-up: error rate ~1.5% over last 10m, no support tickets flagged as high priority yet.

jenna: Draft periodic update:
"Update: Rollback and traffic reroute complete; error rate decreased to ~1–2%.
Impact: Small fraction of embedding requests may still fail.
Next update: in 30 minutes or on status change."

alex-legal: That phrasing looks fine.

jenna: Published periodic update.

sam: Internal note: preliminary hypothesis — tokenizer memory growth introduced by optimization patch. We'll validate with traces and a repro on staging.

maria: Starting extended soak on staging with the optimization disabled. If stable for 30m, we signal resolve and schedule postmortem.

jenna: Resolved draft (internal):
"Resolved: Traffic and error rates have stabilized below 1% after rollback.
Root cause: Investigations indicate a tokenizer memory regression introduced in the recent runtime build; rollback removed the regression.
Next steps: Postmortem, a patch to fix the regression, and customer outreach if needed."

alex-legal: Tweak: use "appear to be" instead of definitive language for root cause.

jenna: Updated resolved copy accordingly.

maria: Confirmed 30 minutes of stability completed at ~14:57 UTC. No new spikes.

jenna: Published resolved notice (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/embeddings-eu-abc/resolved) :white_check_mark:

lee: Filed INF-4521 for the regression patch and added notes to #postmortems.

sam: Thanks all — smooth coordination. We'll include timeline and brief RCA in the postmortem and prep a short customer note if support asks.

maria: On-call handoff complete at 15:10 UTC. Incident closed (duration ~50m).
